expected_findings.evidence: The public Ingest API enforces no authentication on requests.
The internet-facing Ingest API does not sit behind the enterprise WAF.
Vehicle device to Ingest API traffic is plaintext HTTP, not TLS 1.2+.
The confidential Driver Datastore does not state encryption at rest.
The Dispatch Portal uses local application accounts instead of enterprise SSO.
Uses an unapproved mapping database not on the technology catalogue, with no waiver.
Tracking Service is deployed across two availability zones.
Backup and recovery documented with a 4-hour recovery objective.
